name: io.github.orientimhq/swap
title: Orientim protected swap
description: Zero-trust trade execution for AI agents on Solana, verified on your own RPC before you sign.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your own Solana mainnet RPC URL (a provider's free tier is enough), never Orientim's: every swap is checked against it before your wallet signs.

environmentVariables.name: ORIENTIM_WALLET_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a solana-keygen file (a JSON array of 64 numbers) of a wallet of its own, holding only what may be swapped.

environmentVariables.name: JUPITER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own Jupiter API key, free at developers.jup.ag. Strongly recommended: without one Jupiter throttles calls and a swap may stop.

environmentVariables.name: ORIENTIM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional for this server only. Leave unset and the wallet gets its own key (it must hold 0.01 SOL, not spent); that key message accepts orientim.com/terms.

environmentVariables.name: ORIENTIM_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to the owner's limits file; /etc/orientim/policy.json, when it exists, is used instead.

environmentVariables.name: ORIENTIM_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Most tolerance the model may ask for, in bps (10 to 1500). Default 300 (3%). Lower it to hold every quote closer to the market; "auto" is then refused.

environmentVariables.name: ORIENTIM_MAX_PRICE_IMPACT_BPS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Most price impact accepted, in bps (0 to 2000). Default 500 (5%).
